name: Lethal Invasion
detailed_description:
Lethal Invasion is a 3D third-person survival and melee combat game.

In Lethal Invasion, survive hordes of enemies that will appear in each round. In Early Access, there will be one map; in each map, there will be portals where enemies from other realms will appear.

You can equip yourself with new weapons by purchasing them with points earned by eliminating enemies; additionally, you can upgrade them.

Buy single-use skills and equip yourself as best as possible to survive all the rounds.

GAME FEATURES

ENEMIES

The enemies in the only map of Early Access can perform various attacks and, above all, can dodge your attacks. The more rounds that pass, the difficulty will increase and enemies will be harder to eliminate, whether due to their health, their attacks, or the number of times they dodge your attacks.

ROUNDS

In each round, 5 portals will be created that attract demons. Each portal will have a limit of enemies it can attract. Once the enemy limit is reached, the portal will be destroyed. When all 5 portals are destroyed, the players will advance to the next round, and 5 new portals with different limits and possible difficulty improvements will be generated.

UNLOCK NEW AREAS

Unlock new areas of the map by purchasing doors. Each door will have a protective shield; to remove the shield and enter, you must earn the required points asked of you in order to open it and access that area.

POINTS

Players can earn points by eliminating enemies.

Additionally, there is another currency. To obtain LethalCoins, you must exchange points for this currency.

PLAYER FEATURES

  • Dodge enemy attacks.

  • Attack enemies with combos.

  • Buy new weapons.

  • Upgrade weapons.

  • Buy abilities.

PLAYER ATTACKS AND COMBOS

The player can perform unique or combined attacks.

WEAPON PURCHASE UNLOCK

Each weapon will be placed on the walls, but it will have a protective shield that can only be removed with LethalCoin. To buy the weapon, you must remove the shield.

WEAPON PURCHASE

Players can upgrade their equipment with up to 2 weapons. They can buy weapons using points and will have the opportunity to upgrade them to survive more rounds.

SKILL PURCHASE

Players can buy single-use skills with LethalCoin. There will be various skills that will greatly enhance the gaming experience.

WEAPON UPGRADE

They can upgrade weapons using LethalCoin.

The upgrade will increase damage.

PLAYER CUSTOMIZATION

You can customize your player in various colors. You can choose between green, purple, red, blue, and brown.

LANGUAGES

The game is available in multiple languages.

GAME MODES

  • Competitive Invasion Mode: A mode where the player with the most kills wins, up to round 20. Players, using Transformation abilities, can eliminate their rivals for 20 seconds and steal a portion of their points and Lethal Coins; this way they can eliminate more enemies.

  • Cooperative Invasion Mode: A mode where all players must cooperate to survive as many rounds as possible.

short_description: Lethal Invasion is a 3D third-person survival and melee combat game. Fight off increasingly stronger hordes of enemies. Upgrade your weapons, buy single-use skills, and unlock new map areas as you try to survive alone or in online co-op.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Russian
